title: Strange Case of Signor Volta and Mister Nicholson: How Electrochemistry Developed as a Consequence of an Editorial Misconduct
lineage: Historical article quoting Nicholson’s 1800 report; paper is retained locally and the contemporaneous report is not independently inspected.
